profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Konami Gaming, Inc.
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience in requirement gathering, designing, developing, implementing, debugging, and testing of Web applications, Android applications, and DApps in Ethereum and Hyperledger Blockchain

RELEVANT EXPERIENCE
• Wrote smart contracts with solidity and integrated the concepts of Ethereum blockchain and IPFS into websites using Ethereum libraries and technologies (e.g. Infura) to host a blockchain node and access IPFS
• Developed a private decentralized network of sharing propositions from hotels to users using Hyperledger.
• Developed Android and Flutter Applications
• Improved Healthcare Networks using Hyperledger Blockchain
• Developed websites using MongoDB, Express.js, Node.js, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript
• Former graduate assistant for the department of computer science at UNLV
• Consistently delivered working software solutions within given time constraints
• Worked within team environments to accomplish design and development goals
• Consulted with Team Leads, Management, and Clients to design solutions to best fit their needs
• Performed research to provide insightful and resourceful solutions to new issues as they arose in the development lifecycle

SPECIALTIES
• Strong Understanding of C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Dart, Node.js, MongoDB, Express.js, Bootstrap, Unity, Flutter
• History of building solutions with improved functionality and productivity
• Demonstrated ability to acquire technical knowledge and skills rapidly.
• Resourceful problem solver

positions.title: Graduate Assistant (Mobile App Developer)
positions.description:
- Devised an Android and Flutter app of an informational guide that helps educate patients and the general public on geriatric wellness and additional health-related topics.
- Wrote clean, clear, modular code in Java and Dart in Android Studio.
- Frequent meetings with Nevada Interprofessional Healthy Aging Network (NIHAN) team and communication with the project manager to update progress and issues and discuss plans and requirements for the app.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant (Instructor)
positions.description:
- Oversaw and support student learning objectives of an online Introduction to Computers (CS 115) course of 25 students.
- Created Google Drive application assignments and tests on the course content in Canvas.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Design, build, and modify a website from layout to function according to client's specifications using MongoDB, Express.js, and Node.js and AWS Cloud 9 IDE and deployed the app on Heroku.
- Wrote a smart contract with solidity and integrated the concepts of Ethereum blockchain and IPFS into the website using Ethereum libraries and technologies, such as Infura to host a blockchain node and access IPFS.
- Weekly in-person meetings and frequent communication on Slack with team to update progress and issues and discuss future plans and requirements for the project.
- Wrote weekly progress reports and documentation of a complete report on all aspects of project including tutorial on how to use website, software architecture, and schemas and flowcharts of interaction between components .

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
UNLV STEM Summer Camp
- Assisted a professor in mentoring middle and high school students in groups of up to 15.
- Collaborated with the professor to plan a curriculum for the students. 
- Supported classroom activities, including set-up of the classroom, answering questions, and monitoring students' progress in learning Python programming.

positions.title: Program Co-Manager, Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
UNLV AEOP UNITE STEM Summer Camp
- Planned and organized the events of the 6-week program by communicating and collaborating with all involved members, organizational teams, and director of the program.
- Documented multiple reports of the program.
- Assisted and mentored 23 middle and high school students and 13 CCSD teachers in learning Java programming and concepts by guiding them in solving solutions to programming problems.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: - Supported a graduate student with curating and providing annotations for each frame of over 60,000 frames of vehicle tracking datasets from an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in organized Excel sheets.

positions.title: Barista
positions.description:
- Accommodated to customer's needs with a “customer comes first” approach
- Kept a calm demeanor and resolved conflicts during times of high volume and worked collaboratively as a team to provide fast and quality service
- Delivered quality customer service by connecting with the customer and providing consistent beverages by following Starbuck’s standards
- Completed multiple and daily tasks in a punctual manner by direction and self-direction to upkeep the efficiency of the store
- Mastered POS system and multitasking on front and back of house services

educations.fieldOfStudy: Nursing Assistant/Aide and Patient Care Assistant/Aide

honors.title: Dean's Honor List, College of Engineering

volunteerExperiences.description: Greeted patients, families, and guests in a friendly and welcoming manner. Provided information about the hospital and answered any questions. Visited and checked in with patients demonstrating quality bedside manner and provided quality care to the best of my abilities. Brought family members to the back to see patients if allowed. Tidied and cleaned waiting areas. Stocked patient rooms and carts with supplies. Assisted nurses with obtaining materials and supplies, delivering water, wheeling patients, etc.

projects.title: Improving Healthcare Networks using the Hyperledger Fabric Blockchain
projects.description:
- Built a decentralized network of insurances, hospitals, and patients using Hyperledger to share patient and insurance information reducing cost and time.
- Used Hyperledger Composer, JavaScript
